## Conex\]ao R \>\> SQLite

```{r}
#install.packages("DBI")
#install.packages("RSQLite")
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "me315.sqlite")
```

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT * FROM PRESERVE
```

## QUESTÃO 1

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT * FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY ACRES
```

## QUESTÃO 2

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT PNAME, FEE FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE = "MT"
ORDER BY PNAME DESC
```

## QUESTÃO 3

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT FEE, ACRES FROM PRESERVE
ORDER BY FEE, ACRES
```

## QUESTÃO 4

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT PNAME FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE = "AZ"
ORDER BY PNO
```

## QUESTÃO 5

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT STATE, FEE, PNO FROM PRESERVE
WHERE ACRES >= 100
ORDER BY STATE DESC, FEE DESC, PNO
```

## QUESTÃO 6

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT * FROM PRESERVE
WHERE STATE > "M"
```

## QUESTÃO 7

```{sql connection = con}
SELECT * FROM PRESERVE
WHERE PNAME <= "TATKON"
```

# EXERCICIOS EMPLOYEE

## QUESTÃO 9
```{sql connection = con}
SELECT * FROM EMPLOYEE
ORDER BY ENAME
```

## QUESTÃO 10
```{sql connection = con}
SELECT ENAME, SALARY FROM EMPLOYEE
WHERE SALARY > 2000
ORDER BY SALARY DESC
```
## QUESTÃO 11
```{sql connection = con}
SELECT DNO, ENO, ENAME FROM EMPLOYEE
ORDER BY DNO DESC, ENO
```
